description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_WorkAccident"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeNotification" name="Employee notification to employer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorateReport" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport" name="Report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentNotification" name="Student accident report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SchoolAccidentReport" name="School work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateAccidentReport" name="Private insurance accident report"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person" processRef="Process_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EducationFacility" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_EducationFacility"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured person" processRef="Process_PrivateInsured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer"
                      name="Immediate notification"
                      sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer"
                      targetRef="Start_EmployerNotification"
                      messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToLabourInspectorate"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate"
                      targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"
                      messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToAccidentInsurance"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerAccidentInsurance"
                      targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider"
                      messageRef="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToAccidentInsurance"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident"
                      targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider"
                      messageRef="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate"
                      sourceRef="Task_StudentReport"
                      targetRef="Participant_Directorate"
                      messageRef="Message_StudentNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EducationFacilityToAccidentInsurance"
                      sourceRef="Task_SchoolReport"
                      targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider"
                      messageRef="Message_SchoolAccidentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsuredToInsurer"
                      sourceRef="Task_PrivateReport"
                      targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"
                      messageRef="Message_PrivateAccidentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityToInsurer"
                      sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport"
                      targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"
                      messageRef="Message_PrivateAccidentReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee accident notification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeEvent" name="Accident, near accident, serious immediate risk or protection-system defect discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeNotified" name="Employer informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeEvent" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeNotified"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerNotification" name="Employee notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeNotification" messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" name="Gather accident circumstances and affected person's status"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerReportSplit" name="Which reporting obligations apply?" default="Flow_Employer_NoReport"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate, unless reported to emergency services"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportEmployerAccidentInsurance" name="Report insured person's death or injury causing at least three days unable to work to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerReportJoin" name="Complete applicable employer reports"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerReporting" name="Employer reporting complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployerNotification" targetRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_Labour" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportSplit" targetRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression id="Condition_Employer_Labour" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">workAccident and (fatality or seriousInjury) and notReportedToEmergencyServices</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_Insurer" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportSplit" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerAccidentInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression id="Condition_Employer_Insurer" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">workAccident and accidentInsuredPerson and (fatality or unableToWorkForAtLeastThreeDays)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_NoReport" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportSplit" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_LabourToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_InsurerToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerAccidentInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportJoin" targetRef="End_EmployerReporting"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_AccidentCircumstances">
      <bpmn:text>Record circumstances relevant to whether an event is treated as a work accident. For insured gainful employment, examples include: a location, time and cause correlating to the insured employment; working from home; the direct route between permanent residence and work, lunch or home (including carpools); training providing specific professional knowledge and the direct route to or from its centre; a route between home, workplace or training centre and a doctor that interrupts the direct route (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance); travel to or from work or a training centre to take a child with supervisory responsibility to, or collect them from, childcare, daycare, external care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include circumstances, time and cause correlating to the insured school, university or compulsory kindergarten education; school or school-related events; the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school and home; practical tasks prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered tasks may, depending on the protected group, include work in a household serving the company to a considerable extent; accommodation for guests; secondary occupations selling farm products; erecting, converting or repairing buildings serving the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Other situations treated as work accidents outside professional activity include activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act (for example, travel to an arranged job interview); assisting at an accident or donating blood; and training, exercises or service as a member of a listed aid organisation, including volunteer fire brigade, water rescue or rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, and radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_AccidentCircumstances" sourceRef="Task_GatherAccidentInformation" targetRef="Annotation_AccidentCircumstances"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Accident involving the self-employed person or a person they employ"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident" name="Report the accident to the accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReported" name="Accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_1" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_2" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student and schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Accident involving a student or schoolchild"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StudentReport" name="Report the accident to the competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReported" name="Directorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_1" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_2" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="End_StudentReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EducationFacility" name="Education facility accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SchoolReport" name="Report the work accident to the accident insurance provider in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SchoolReported" name="Accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_1" sourceRef="Start_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Task_SchoolReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_2" sourceRef="Task_SchoolReport" targetRef="End_SchoolReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsured" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="Accident involving a privately insured person"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrivateReport" name="Report the accident in writing immediately under the policy conditions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Were there fatalities?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report the fatality within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateNoFatality" name="Immediate accident report complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateFatalityReported" name="Fatality reported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_1" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_PrivateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_2" sourceRef="Task_PrivateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_NoFatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateNoFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression id="Condition_Private_NoFatality" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">not fatalities</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression id="Condition_Private_Fatality" language="http://www.w3.org/1999/XPath">fatalities</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_3" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="End_PrivateFatalityReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
